content:
Users who post statuses on WhatsApp can now share longer music clips, with the length limit doubled to 30 seconds. Here are the details.

WhatsApp status music clip duration increased to 30 seconds

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is rolling out support for music clips of up to 30 seconds in status updates.

Status updates are a WhatsApp feature similar to Instagram Stories; previously, posts containing music were limited to 15 seconds.

Now, users can select a segment of up to 30 seconds from a song and post it together with a photo, or share it directly as a music clip status update.

Below is WABetaInfo's explanation of how to select the length of a music clip under the new 30-second limit:

As is typically the case with WhatsApp rolling out new features on the server side, the new 30-second limit is not yet available to all users. However, WABetaInfo notes that on both iOS and Android platforms, some users have already seen the new limit. On the iOS side, the website lists WhatsApp version 26.35.72 as the compatible update.
